messages:
sam: quick sync 97 - SDK PR #521 needs the api change in api-core#142 and a helm value tweak in charts#47. can we sequence these so CI doesn't flip? cc @maria @lee
maria: I looked at #521, SDK changes are fine. api-core#142 bumps response schema for streaming metadata and relies on runtime#412 to expose the new cache flag. If api goes in before runtime, integration streaming tests fail. :grimacing:
lee: confirmed. runtime#412 adds a feature flag `enable_prefetch_kv`. api-core#142 reads it. runtime CI is green on staging. api-core CI shows failures in streaming tests.
ci-bot: runtime#412: ✅ unit + integration (staging)
ci-bot: api-core#142: ❌ streaming-tests (timeout)
ci-bot: sdk#521: ✅ basic checks, needs matrix run for console compat
sam: proposed order: runtime#412 -> api-core#142 (canary) -> sdk#521 -> charts#47. canary plan: namespace=canary-serving, 20% traffic 90m, smoke evals. Friday merge window open 15:30 PT. anyone object?
maria: that order looks right. I can take api review tomorrow morning and run the canary harness. would like an extra logging flag in runtime to debug kv misses during canary. lee can you add?
lee: yeah I'll add a `kv_diagnostics` opt-in flag and a short note in CHANGELOG. should be a small patch. aiming to finish in 3 hours.
sam: great. once runtime merges I'll trigger a rebuild of api-core and post smoke results here. olivia can you own helm bump and release notes?
olivia: yup, I'll update charts#47 with values schema bump and a migration note. will also draft the release notes and coordinate a deploy in #eng-releases. plan to hold full rollout until Monday morning if any regressions appear.
maria: small ask: sdk#521 renames optional param `meta` -> `metadataOpt`. please add a compatibility test in sdk matrix so console and plugins are validated.
sam: good catch. I'll add a test and mention the opt-in behavior in PR description.
lee: runtime patch ready, adding logging flag and reverting behavior behind feature flag for older clients. pushing now.
ci-bot: runtime#412: ✅ new build passing, will merge after approvals.
lee: left a short review note for sam about backward compat flag default.
sam: thanks. once runtime merges i'll rerun api-core CI and tag maria for final sign-off. timeline suggestion: runtime merge today by EOD, api canary Fri 08:30 PT, full api merge Fri 10:30 PT if canary stable, sdk merge Fri 13:00 PT, charts Fri 16:00 PT. ok with everyone?
maria: works for me. I'll schedule the canary and pre-run smoke evals. olivia: I'll prepare helm canary steps and the rollback playbook.
ci-bot: sdk#521: ✅ matrix baseline pending console compat run
sam: thanks all. i'll monitor CI and ping if anything flares up. please DM me for hot-blockers. :thumbsup:
